instruction: I have drafted my resignation email on Gmail. Attach "~/documents/work/letter_of_resignation.pdf" from my file system to it and schedule it to be sent to my manager on next Wednesday at 11 am.
notes: Three apps need tokens: gmail (draft lookup, attachment upload, draft update), file_system (its token is passed as file_system_access_token to upload_attachments_to_draft), and phone (search_contacts with relationship=manager yields the manager's email; get_current_date_and_time supports computing 'next Wednesday 11am' = 2023-05-24T11:00:00). The draft is discovered with gmail.show_drafts (query 'resignation'); known-id gates the upload and update. gmail.update_draft sets only email_addresses and scheduled_send_at so no other draft field changes, matching the evaluation (one updated Draft, one added Attachment). Static 'target' facts (attachment-target, recipient-target, schedule-target, email-of) tie the single draft to the required file, recipient person and datetime; supervisor-complete-task takes these task records as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the goal and it must be last.
